why: A January 2025 arXiv preprint (2502.03474, Mantzakouras and Lopez Zapata, 'Diophantine FLINT-HILLS series') claims to prove convergence of the Flint Hills series, directly resolving the stated open question; a further October 2025 preprint (2510.27041) builds on this connecting convergence to the irrationality measure of pi.
